items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And the guy playing baritone for trombone in the band. He had no trombone, he played a baritone. You know, plays with trombone. Willie Cornish.

ctx.x: Was it a homemade violin or a regular violin?

No, a regular violin. Yeah, we was playing a real instrument then. And he was too? We were professional. We were playing professionally then. Yeah. That's how I met Freddie. Mm-hmm. And the guy playing baritone for trombone in the band. He had no trombone, he played a baritone. You know, plays with trombone. Willie Cornish.
